live_core.O: one OperatorRegistry on that runtime; work.Operator is a parallel schema, not a second field

items.detail: ocm.runtime.OCMRuntime is the M0 Boolean-procedure custody runtime. Live cognition imports ocm.runtime.ocm_runtime.OCMRuntime. Not deleted.

work.Operator/Skill operate on dict state with KSO WarrantProfile/Authority/Scope. Not a second warrant lattice or truth store. Unification into OperatorSpec is not required to freeze G1.1 and was not performed.
MeaningGraph is a compact language representation. Persistent identity goes through representation atoms + correspondence warrant on the KSO. Not a second truth store.
Speaker commitments stay speaker authority. Binding reuses language.field_bridge. Retraction revokes the same evidence id.
KnowledgeSpace / GovernedSpace / RecursiveKSO / UnifiedKSO are documented as views of one object. No second live field.
KSO contract calls navigation Π_t. Issue #165 calls the executive Π_t. This freeze names them Π_nav and Π_exec. Not two cores.
